notes: Fit a multinomial Naive Bayes model from a CSV corpus (exact tokenization, Laplace smoothing, priors) and persist it to a pickle file at a fixed path. The verifier reloads the pickle and checks the exact dict layout, sorted class/vocab lists, and smoothed log-probabilities against a reference, then re-runs the deliverable on hidden corpora (different class set, punctuation-only documents). Nonzero rubric for the fit-then-persist chain, adversarial empty-token documents, hidden generalization, and numeric correctness.
